args.title: Ironbark Tooling — Cold-chain logistics in 2026
args.body:
- Ironbark Tooling’s latest newsletter highlights its outlook on cold-chain logistics in 2026 and points readers to the main article and companion analysis.
- The main article reports that temperature excursions fell 30% when carriers shared live sensor data; most savings came from fewer rejected loads rather than reduced spoilage.
- The companion piece says pilot programs reduced claims by 25%.
